answer: Reaching the timber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Work waits on the orchard until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the kernel of the next round.
